$comment: Authoritative subsystem partition for indie-review / review-code. docs/subsystems.md describes these lanes in prose; change both together. Pinned because the computed fallback groups by directory, which put the whole of ui/ -- window, dialogs, theming and workers -- into one 2,968-line lane.

lanes.name: render-engine
lanes.summary: Turns a flat cover into a 3D box: perspective transform, shading, reflection, shadow, and the PNG write.

lanes.name: image-analysis
lanes.summary: Decides what an input image is and manufactures what it lacks: full-cover detection and splitting, spine location, generated spine art.

lanes.name: case-model
lanes.summary: The real-world measurements every render is built from, the platform-to-case mapping, and the persisted settings.

lanes.name: api-clients
lanes.summary: Everything that talks to a third party. Reviewed against the security invariants in CLAUDE.md and SECURITY.md: allowlist, redirect revalidation, size caps, accepted formats, credential scrubbing, TLS.

lanes.name: main-window
lanes.summary: Menu and toolbar construction, the load-render-export flow, and the window's own state. The largest file in the project; worth splitting further when a review has the budget (SLIP-0025).

lanes.name: workers
lanes.summary: QThread and process-pool workers for batch rendering, animation export and search. Reviewed against the memory and cleanup rules in CLAUDE.md.

lanes.name: dialogs
lanes.summary: The screens reached from the main window, and the preview surface.

lanes.name: entry-point
lanes.summary: Process start-up: the decompression-bomb ceiling, theme selection, and constructing the window.

lanes.name: ci-and-gate
lanes.summary: The one list of checks and the workflow that calls it. Not Python, so the computed partition never covered it.

lanes.name: tests
lanes.summary: The test suite. review-code excludes this lane; review-tests is exactly this lane.
